VERDICT: moderate

The three evidence items I relied on:
- `UE-tf04d:ticket_lists_item`: the ticket lists Veg Biryani, so the order was prepared as placed. It doesn't prove the item was packed.
- `UE-tf04d:pickup_handoff`: the order was ready at 12:50 and picked up at 12:53.
- `UE-tf04d:repeat_claimant`: the account made 3 claims this payout period. This is a factual count only.

Nothing returned shows what was in the bag, so the case rests on the ticket and the handoff timing.

Updated win probability: 77%, up from 45%. The case is not flagged weak.
